title: Vantage Box settings
description: Vantage Box settings. The file is read as JSONC — comments and trailing commas are allowed.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema — enables editor autocomplete.

configPath.description: Path to the sing-box config.json. Vantage Box never overwrites it: a runtime copy is created for launch.

binaryPath.description: Path to the sing-box binary. Empty — the file managed by Vantage Box is used.

updatePolicy.description: sing-box auto-update. With a custom binaryPath, updates are never applied — only notifications.

clashApi.description: Connection to the sing-box Clash API (experimental.clash_api).

url.description: Base address of the Clash API. Must be loopback.

secret.description: Secret from the sing-box config. Empty if the API is open without authorization.

logLevel.description: Level at which Vantage Box subscribes to the /logs stream.

closeToTray.description: Closing the window minimizes to the tray instead of exiting the app.

hotkeys.description: Hotkeys in tauri-plugin-global-shortcut format, e.g. "Ctrl+Alt+P". Global ones work even when the window is closed; in-app ones only while the window is focused. An empty string disables a binding.

showMain.description: Global: show and focus the main window.

restart.description: Global: soft restart of the current run.

goToSettings.description: In-app: jump to the Settings tab.

nextTab.description: In-app: cycle to the next tab.

prevTab.description: In-app: cycle to the previous tab.

tabIndex.description: In-app: modifier prefix — digits 1–9 jump to the corresponding tab.

autostart.description: Launch Vantage Box at system login.

policy.description: off — do not check; notify — notify when available; auto — install automatically.

subscriptions.description: Proxy-list subscriptions. Nodes are merged into the sing-box config.json and applied with a soft restart.

targetGroup.description: Selector-group tag to merge nodes into. null — into all selector/urltest groups.

updateInterval.description: How often to re-pull the subscription, in hours.

fallback.description: Auto-switch selector groups to a backup node when the active one goes down.

intervalSec.description: How often the active node is pinged, in seconds.

maxDelayMs.description: Latency above this is considered bad. 0 — only total unavailability.

groups.description: Group tags to monitor. Empty — all selector groups.
